MINI MINUTES:

No appearances. The Court adopts the tentative ruling as follows:

Defendant Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC's unopposed Demurrer to Complaint is OFF CALENDAR.

On July 21, 2026, Plaintiff filed and served a First Amended Complaint. Thus, the instant demurrer to Plaintiff's initial complaint it moot and, on those grounds, the court orders the instant demurrer off calendar.

Moving Defendant is ordered to prepare a proposed order which repeats the above text verbatim and email it to contestdept302tr@sftc.org prior to the time set for hearing.

No proposed order received. Moving Defendant failed to provide and follow the court's order.

Moving party is required to prepare a proposed order which repeats verbatim the court's ruling and must drop a hard courtesy copy in Dept. 302's inbox.
